en.a1: You know that group you love? Your neighbours. Your hobby. Your people.
en.a2: On most apps, it belongs to a company. They fill it with ads. They decide what you see.
en.a3: And one day, they can simply switch it off.
en.c1: A place to post, chat, and build communities that belong to the people in them.
en.c2: Share a photo. Ask a question. Start a conversation.
en.f3: And you decide what's in your feed.
en.e1: Private groups and messages stay private. Only you and your friends can read them.
en.d1: And because your community lives on its members' devices, not in one company's building,
en.g1: Interpoll. Your community, in your hands.
en.g2: It's free, and there's nothing to install. Just open endless dot social.

fr.a3: Et un jour, elle peut tout simplement le supprimer.
fr.b1: Alors, nous avons créé autre chose.
fr.c1: Un endroit pour publier, discuter, et créer des communautés qui appartiennent à leurs membres.
fr.c2: Partagez une photo. Posez une question. Lancez une conversation.
fr.f3: Et c'est vous qui choisissez ce que vous voyez.
